title: Agency portal (dubizzle Pro) — as captured

summary.problem: The agency portal has no hand-off document: engineers and PMs working on dubizzle Pro have only live production and a folder of captures to learn what exists.
summary.scope: The 8 portal screens (Dashboard, Agency Ads, Candidates, Leads, VIP Leads, Agency Management, Insights, Credit Info) plus their drawers, modals and filter states: 30 captured pages, desktop only.
summary.changed: Nothing is redesigned. This is a record of production as captured from a test agency account (owner view, English), with people-rows replaced by fixtures. v1 is the first build.

signoff.meaning: the document matches live production; it is not a new design

exclude.tokens: the screens are frozen live captures; their CSS is production's own, not this system's token sheet
exclude.motion: no motion was measured on the portal

rules.text: The portal is desktop only. There is no mobile layout and none is to be designed (decision D-012).
rules.test: The registry lists the portal pages on portal-desktop only; every page records 'dubizzle Pro has no mobile layout (D-012)' as its unpaired mobile reason.

rules.text: Navigation is a collapsed icon rail 80px wide with eight entries, in this order: Dashboard, Agency Ads, Candidates, Leads, VIP Leads, Agency Management, Insights, Credit Info. Each entry is 56px tall on a 60px pitch (4px gap).
rules.test: On portal-dashboard at 1440px the eight sidebar links render in that order, 56px tall, starting 76px from the top.

rules.text: The portal URL space is /en/agencyPortal, camelCase. Lowercase spellings do not exist and there is no public entry point: the way in is 'Partner with dubizzle' in the signed-in user menu, with an agency account.
rules.test: Each page's source route matches the route table in docs/PAGE-COVERAGE.md.

rules.text: Tables that list people (Leads, VIP Leads, Candidates, Agency Management, Dashboard lists) contain fixture rows only in anything committed or shared. A real phone number reached disk once (D-011).
rules.test: The captured pages contain no email address and no Egyptian mobile number; the build's scan reports zero hits.

acceptance: Clicking any of the eight sidebar entries on any portal screen opens that screen.
Every drawer, modal and filter state listed on a main screen appears as its own state screen in this document.
edge_cases: The captured account is an owner. What an Agent (non-owner) sees is not captured, so it is not documented here.
Credit Info > Agents with no consumption shows 'Nothing to show yet' in the Consumption Log (the only portal empty state captured).

open_questions.q: What does an Agent (non-owner) see? Which sidebar entries and pages are hidden for agents? Only the owner view was captured.
What do Agency Ads, Leads, VIP Leads, Candidates and Agency Management show with zero rows? The only empty state in the captures is the Credit Info > Agents consumption log ('Nothing to show yet').
Which sidebar entries depend on account settings (for example Insights, VIP Leads, Candidates)? The capture shows all eight for this test agency.
Is there an Arabic portal? Arabic was never captured, so right-to-left behaviour of the rail, drawers and tables is unknown.

changelog.notes: First build: record of the 30 captured portal pages (owner view, English, desktop). No redesign.
